requirements.text: AcroForm fields are listed with fully qualified names, kinds, current values and options
Text, checkbox, radio and choice fields are filled by name; unknown names and invalid options are refused before writing
Filled values render in every viewer (appearance streams generated), including non-Latin text with an embedded font
The output can be flattened so values can no longer be edited
Uploaded PDFs are size-bounded and parsed in isolation; encrypted and XFA forms are refused clearly
The original template is preserved and the filled output is stored and served only to authorized users

implementations.notes: Wraps maintained PDF libraries; per-language tests under examples/cookbook only. Radio groups and non-Latin fonts are documented, not tested; flatten is unavailable in some languages
